---
title: "Theme declaring a null body-bg and body-color"
format:
  html:
    theme:
      - default
      - custom-15304.scss
_quarto:
  tests:
    html:
      ensureCssRegexMatches:
        - ['#test-15304\s*\{\s*background-color:\s*#fff;\s*color:\s*#212529;?\s*\}']
---

A theme that declares `$body-bg: null !default;` or `$body-color: null !default;`
must render with Bootstrap's default body colours.
